# Code Review — 2026-08-06

Evidence-based review (01-code-review) of Cycle_03 scope: the commits of this cycle on
main (`b99b76e` Meet page, `ea64669` Tune repositioning, `5c941cc` Tune funnel + GA4,
`e3247b2` CI workflow_dispatch) — diff `2bf3790..HEAD`, 17 files, +1393/−40.

Verified locally: `npm run lint` clean, `npm run build` clean (415 kB JS / 116 kB gzip).

## Security

No issue-worthy code-level security findings. Verified in the diff:
- All analytics events gated by `hasAnalyticsConsent()` (localStorage
  `symaira-cookie-consent === 'accepted'`, fail-closed on storage errors) —
  `src/config/analytics.ts:57-85`.
- Event params restricted to `string | number | boolean`; the Tune funnel only sends
  edition, locale, cta_type, price_variant, use_case — no PII/device data
  (`analytics.ts:75-85`, `TuneFunnel.tsx:73-99`).
- No secrets, network calls, `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, or `console.*` in the cycle's
  code. Email address only ever leaves via the visitor's own mail client
  (`TuneFunnel.tsx:96-97`).
- The one real security gap is CI config, not code: deploy uses plaintext FTP — covered
  in the gh-audit report (`.github/audit/2026-08-06T22-09-30Z.md`), not duplicated here.

## UX/DX

- [ ] **[UX/DX] Copy button claims success even when the clipboard write fails**
  - **Status quo:** `TuneFunnel.tsx:67-71` calls `navigator.clipboard.writeText` without
    awaiting or catching; `setCopied(true)` runs unconditionally, so on insecure contexts
    or denied permission the UI shows "copied" although nothing was copied.
  - **Proposed solution:** `await` the write in a `try/catch`; only set the copied state
    on success, keep it unchanged on failure (no false success message).
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / low impact. *(Fixed directly — see PR #11.)*

- [ ] **[UX/DX] `tune_page_view` re-fires on locale switch**
  - **Status quo:** `ToolPage.tsx:44-50` lists `language` in the effect deps, so toggling
    EN/DE on the Tune page fires a second `tune_page_view` for the same visit.
  - **Proposed solution:** Track the last reported locale (or the product identity only)
    in a ref and fire only on first mount per product.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / low impact. Acceptable as-is (page content does change
    with locale); decided to keep for the analytics value of locale-switch signal.

## Architecture

- [ ] **[Architecture] Meet terminal demo block duplicated verbatim**
  - **Status quo:** The identical ~25-line `product-demo-terminal` block for Meet exists
    in `ToolPage.tsx:716-739` and `Tools.tsx:685-706` (aria-hidden demo, same classes,
    same translation keys).
  - **Proposed solution:** Extract a shared `MeetTerminalDemo` component
    (`src/components/`) and render it from both places; remove the now-unused `Mic`
    import where applicable.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / low impact. *(Fixed directly — see PR #11.)*

- Notes (not findings, by convention): TuneEditions/TuneFunnel continue the codebase's
  existing inline-style pattern; EN/DE content stays centralized in
  `LanguageContext.tsx` (documented convention in AGENTS.md); Tune config is cleanly
  centralized in `src/config/tune.ts` with feature-flag switches.

## Performance

No issue-worthy findings. Static site, 116 kB gzip JS; the new visibility/analytics
instrumentation is observer-based with once-flags and disconnect-on-cleanup
(`TuneEditions.tsx:52-108`), no polling, no timers beyond a 2 s clipboard reset.

## Conclusion

The cycle's code is in good shape: honest-copy marketing (draft prices labeled as draft,
"not a purchase" funnel), consent-gated analytics with minimal event surface, and a
single config source for Tune. Two small issues found — clipboard error handling and
duplicated demo markup — both fixed directly in PR #11. Quick win: none needed; the code
itself is merge-ready.
